agent_request_anchor._doc: ORPHAN-MEDIUM-492 — how long a minted agent-invocation request stays claimable. target_sha names the commit the request's plan and evidence are grounded at; past this window the request describes a tree the repo has moved off. The nightly cadence is daily and a request is meant to be consumed by the cycle that minted it, so 3 days is already generous. Age is the check that binds on the live lane: it needs no git history, so it works on the depth-1 shallow clone actions/checkout gives both ARIA workflows. Reachability is checked ONLY when an anchor is present AND the clone is not shallow (ORPHAN-CRITICAL-494) — in a partial clone, absence of the object is not evidence the commit is gone.

auto_promote._doc: Plan ARIA-V6 §2e v2 — narrow auto-promotion exception. Default disabled; operator MUST opt-in via override. Even when enabled, the operator_approval path is UNCHANGED — auto-promote is a parallel admission, not a replacement.

circuit_breaker._doc: ORPHAN-MEDIUM-483 / RC-4 — failure_window_hours is DELIBERATELY ABSENT. It is derived as minimum_window_hours(failure_threshold) = threshold x cadence + cadence, so for threshold 3 on the nightly's 24h cadence the window is 96. This file used to ship the literal 72, which is exactly the boundary the derivation exists to forbid: failures land at t=0/24/48 and the gate reads at t=72, so a 72h window puts the oldest failure on the edge and ±30min of cron jitter flips the verdict. Worse, the loader silently widened 72 to 96, so this file documented a number the code refused to honour and an operator reading it learned the wrong thing about their own breaker. Setting the key here again, or below the floor in an override, is now REFUSED with both numbers named rather than silently corrected.

convergent_authoring._doc: Plan ARIA-V6 §2d v2 — convergent adapter authoring loop config. Operator opt-in via skill-genesis request --convergent.

drift_class_weights._doc: Plan S4 (ORPHAN-MEDIUM-298) - per-drift-class pressure score multipliers. 1.0 = neutral (default behaviour is bit-identical); >1.0 biases cycles toward that class, <1.0 deprioritizes. Applied in pressure.run_pressure AFTER base scoring, re-capped at 100. Override via <repo>/aria-config/genesis_policy.json.

genesis_lifecycle._doc: Enterprise autonomy lifecycle gate. Skill/agent genesis cannot jump from pressure gap to request/draft/materialization without HUMAN_REQUIRED, real sandbox, SHADOW, EVAL_WINDOW and ACTIVE evidence.

skill_genesis_drainer._doc: Plan ARIA-V7 §2h v2 — V7.4 skill_genesis_drainer per-cycle config. Default enabled (drainer fires every cycle to consume convergent=True requests); operator sets enabled=false to disable drainer entirely.
